outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of pseudocoloured micrographs (time-lapse confocal images) showing photoactivation regions; it is not a plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.

Panel B shows normalized intensity vs. time as scatter plots (red/green dots for euchromatin/heterochromatin) with fitted model curves overlaid; the underlying individual measurement points are directly visible rather than being reduced to a single summary line. The insets similarly show individual early time-point data with error bars. Since raw data points are already plotted, the individual-data-points requirement is satisfied.
